code: split <- balanced_initial_split(   d,   prop = 0.8,   balance = c(age, income),   exact = c(diagnosis, site) ) train <- rsample::training(split) balance_check(split) #> # Balance check: 1 split, 4 variables #> # |SMD| above chance (95%) in 0 of 4 variables, ratio to chance 0.0659, #> # energy distance 0.0207 #>  #> variable   level         SMD  chance 95% #> age                -0.000237       0.255 #> income              0.00179        0.258 #> diagnosis  none    -0.00846        0.348 #> diagnosis  mild     0.00927 #> diagnosis  severe   0 #> site       A        0.026          0.327 #> site       B       -0.00923 #> site       C       -0.0174 #>  #> # tibble::as_tibble() gives all 17 rows. folds <- balanced_vfold_cv(   train,   v = 5,   balance = c(age, income),   exact = c(diagnosis, site) ) library(ggplot2) autoplot(balance_check(folds)) library(balancedsample) library(parsnip) library(tune) library(workflows)  wf <- workflow(   outcome ~ age + income + diagnosis + site,   decision_tree(     tree_depth = tune(),     min_n = tune(),     mode = "regression"   ) ) res <- tune_grid(wf, resamples = folds, grid = 6) show_best(res, metric = "rmse", n = 3) #> # A tibble: 3 × 8 #>   tree_depth min_n .metric .estimator  mean     n std_err .config         #>        <int> <int> <chr>   <chr>      <dbl> <int>   <dbl> <chr>           #> 1          6     2 rmse    standard    1.12     5  0.0457 pre0_mod3_post0 #> 2         12     9 rmse    standard    1.13     5  0.0417 pre0_mod5_post0 #> 3          9    24 rmse    standard    1.13     5  0.0416 pre0_mod4_post0 final <- finalize_workflow(wf, select_best(res, metric = "rmse")) final_fit <- last_fit(final, split) collect_metrics(final_fit) #> # A tibble: 2 × 4 #>   .metric .estimator .estimate .config         #>   <chr>   <chr>          <dbl> <chr>           #> 1 rmse    standard       1.23  pre0_mod0_post0 #> 2 rsq     standard       0.388 pre0_mod0_post0
